name: Top-level genres (roots)
query: MATCH (g:Genre) WHERE NOT (g)-[:SUBGENRE_OF]->() RETURN g.genre_title AS genre ORDER BY genre

name: Subgenres per genre
query: MATCH (g:Genre)<-[:SUBGENRE_OF]-(c:Genre) RETURN g.genre_title AS genre, count(c) AS subgenres ORDER BY subgenres DESC

name: Graph counts (nodes)
query: MATCH (n) RETURN labels(n) AS label, count(*) AS n ORDER BY n DESC

name: Graph counts (relationships)
query: MATCH ()-[r]->() RETURN type(r) AS rel, count(*) AS n ORDER BY n DESC

name: Top artists by listeners
query: MATCH (:User)-[:PLAYS]->(a:Artist) RETURN a.name AS artist, count(*) AS listeners ORDER BY listeners DESC LIMIT 25

name: Top artists by total plays
query: MATCH (:User)-[r:PLAYS]->(a:Artist) RETURN a.name AS artist, sum(r.play_count) AS total_plays ORDER BY total_plays DESC LIMIT 25

name: Fans also listen to (edit artist)
query: MATCH (a:Artist {name:'radiohead'})<-[:PLAYS]-(u:User)-[:PLAYS]->(rec:Artist) WHERE rec <> a RETURN rec.name AS also_listened, count(DISTINCT u) AS shared_fans ORDER BY shared_fans DESC LIMIT 20

name: Most devoted fans of an artist (edit)
query: MATCH (u:User)-[r:PLAYS]->(:Artist {name:'radiohead'}) RETURN u.user_id AS user, u.country AS country, r.play_count AS plays ORDER BY plays DESC LIMIT 20

name: Listeners by country
query: MATCH (u:User)-[:PLAYS]->() RETURN u.country AS country, count(DISTINCT u) AS users ORDER BY users DESC LIMIT 25

name: Listeners by gender
query: MATCH (u:User)-[:PLAYS]->() RETURN u.gender AS gender, count(DISTINCT u) AS users ORDER BY users DESC

name: Artists a user loves (edit user_id)
query: MATCH (u:User {user_id:'CHANGE_ME'})-[r:PLAYS]->(a:Artist) RETURN a.name AS artist, r.play_count AS plays ORDER BY plays DESC LIMIT 25
